      <div class="ops-link-list"><a href="/page/pf2e-ops-initiative"><strong>Initiative</strong><span>Separate Stealth initiative from detection.</span></a><a href="/page/pf2e-ops-movement-positioning"><strong>Movement & positioning</strong><span>Resolve spaces, lines, and flanking.</span></a></div>
    </section>
</div>

name: Dying & Recovery
content:
<style data-pf2e-operations-center>

/* PF2E Operations Center --------------------------------------------------
   Scoped to system Pages so the optional GM reference never changes the
   existing rule, creature, character, or compendium presentations. */
.pf2e-ops {
  --ops-paper: #f9f5ec;
  --ops-panel: #fffdf8;
  --ops-panel-alt: #f1eadc;
  --ops-ink: #2c211b;
  --ops-muted: #655b54;
  --ops-accent: #5e0000;
  --ops-accent-soft: #eadbd3;
  --ops-green: #245735;
  --ops-gold: #dbc385;
  --ops-line: #c9bba8;
  --ops-link: #005e82;

  min-height: 100%;
  padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  background: var(--ops-paper);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.pf2e-ops *,
.pf2e-ops *::before,
.pf2e-ops *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.pf2e-ops a {
  color: var(--ops-link);
}

.ops-breadcrumbs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs > span {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a:last-of-type {
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header {
  position: relative;
  padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.65rem);
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  background-image: url('images/header-paper.jpg');
  background-size: cover;
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-top: 0.38rem solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 0.25rem;
  content: '';
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ops-accent) 0 34%, var(--ops-gold) 34% 100%);
}

.ops-header h1 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 6vw, 2.8rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.ops-header > p:last-child {
  max-width: 50rem;
  margin: 0.45rem 0 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ops-overline,
.ops-kicker,
.ops-card-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-green);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.075em;
}

.ops-section {
  margin-top: 1.2rem;
}

.ops-section-heading {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-section-heading h2,
.ops-section-heading p {
  margin: 0;
}

.ops-section-heading > span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.ops-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 15rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.7rem;
}

.ops-card {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 7.25rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-left: 0.32rem solid var(--ops-green);
  color: var(--ops-ink) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-card:hover,
.ops-card:focus-visible {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  border-left-color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-card strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.13rem;
}

.ops-card > span:last-child {
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.ops-intro,
.ops-callout {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem;
  margin: 0.85rem 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  border-left: 0.35rem solid var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-callout-warn {
  background: #f4e8cf;
  border-left-color: #9a5d18;
}

.ops-callout > strong,
.ops-intro > strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-answer {
  padding: 0.8rem 0.95rem;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-top: 0.3rem solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-answer h2,
.ops-answer p:last-child,
.ops-answer ol:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.ops-answer h2 {
  margin-top: 0;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-procedure {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  list-style: none;
  counter-reset: none;
}

.ops-procedure > li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2.5rem 1fr;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-procedure > li > span {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.35rem;
  height: 2.35rem;
  place-items: center;
  background: var(--ops-accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-procedure strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.ops-procedure p {
  margin: 0.2rem 0 0.35rem;
}

.ops-table-wrap {
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-table {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-table th,
.ops-table td {
  padding: 0.52rem 0.62rem;
  border-bottom-color: var(--ops-line);
  vertical-align: top;
}

.ops-table thead th {
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
}

.ops-table tbody th {
  color: var(--ops-green);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-table tbody th small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.1rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-weight: 400;
  white-space: normal;
}

.ops-action-group > h2 {
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
  margin: 1.2rem 0 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-action-table {
  min-width: 43rem;
}

.ops-action-cost {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  align-items: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-action-cost img {
  width: 1.35rem;
  height: 1.35rem;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.ops-action-meta,
.ops-action-training {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.ops-action-meta {
  gap: 0.28rem;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.ops-action-training {
  gap: 0.2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.ops-proficiency {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 1.25rem;
  padding: 0.12rem 0.32rem;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 0.2rem;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.035em;
  line-height: 1.05;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-proficiency-trained {
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-proficiency-untrained {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-proficiency-rank {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ops-gold) 42%, var(--ops-panel));
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-table-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-number-table td,
.ops-number-table thead th:not(:first-child) {
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.8rem;
}

/* Source-backed reference pickers show one row, not a 25-level-wide table. */
.ops-ref-picker {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  padding: 0.8rem;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-ref-picker h2 {
  margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.ops-ref-controls {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 10rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.ops-ref-controls label {
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-ref-controls select {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 2.4rem;
  margin: 0.2rem 0 0;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.45rem;
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
  font: inherit;
}

.ops-ref-values {
  margin-top: 0.65rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-ref-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 44%) minmax(0, 56%);
  gap: 0.4rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.ops-ref-row strong {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-ref-row span {
  min-width: 0;
}

.ops-ref-source {
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.ops-ref-full {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-symbol-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(7.5rem, 1fr));
  gap: 0.55rem;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
}

.ops-symbol-row > div {
  display: grid;
  min-height: 6.4rem;
  padding: 0.55rem;
  place-items: center;
  align-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-symbol-row img {
  width: 1.8rem;
  height: 1.8rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.ops-symbol-row strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-symbol-row span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.ops-checklist {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.ops-checklist li {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-checklist li:nth-child(odd) {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
}

.ops-checklist strong {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-rule-links,
.ops-related {
  margin-top: 1.15rem;
}

.ops-rule-links h2,
.ops-related h2 {
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-exit-link,
.ops-link-list > a {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 3.75rem;
  padding: 0.62rem 0.75rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-ink) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-exit-link > span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ops-exit-link > strong,
.ops-link-list strong {
  color: var(--ops-link);
}

.ops-tool-link {
  border-left: 0.32rem solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-link-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 14rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.55rem;
}

.ops-link-list span {
  margin-top: 0.15rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
}

.ops-launch {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0.9rem;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  background: var(--ops-green);
  color: #fff;
}

.ops-launch h2,
.ops-launch p {
  margin: 0;
  color: inherit;
}

.ops-launch .ops-kicker {
  color: var(--ops-gold);
}

.ops-launch > a {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--ops-paper);
  color: var(--ops-accent) !important;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-footer {
  padding: 1rem 0 0.25rem;
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-disclosure {
  margin: 0.7rem 0;
}

.ops-disclosure > summary {
  min-height: 2.6rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem;
  background: var(--xp-panel-alt, var(--ops-panel-alt));
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--xp-accent, var(--ops-accent));
  color: var(--xp-accent, var(--ops-accent));
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-disclosure[open] > summary {
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary::marker,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary::marker {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary span:last-child,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary span:last-child {
  float: right;
  margin-left: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 400;
}

.ops-action-disclosure .ops-table-wrap {
  margin: 0;
  border-top: 0;
}

.ops-index-disclosure .ops-link-list {
  padding-top: 0.1rem;
}

@media (max-width: 650px) {
  .pf2e-ops {
    padding: 0.45rem;
    font-size: 0.84rem;
  }

  .ops-breadcrumbs {
    gap: 0.28rem;
    min-height: 2.1rem;
    padding: 0.1rem 0;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
  }

  .ops-breadcrumbs a {
    min-height: 1.75rem;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.3rem;
    background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
    border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  }

  .ops-header {
    padding: 0.62rem 0.72rem 0.72rem;
    border-top-width: 0.25rem;
  }

  .ops-header h1 {
    font-size: 1.58rem;
    line-height: 1.05;
  }

  .ops-header > p:last-child {
    margin-top: 0.22rem;
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  .ops-overline,
  .ops-kicker,
  .ops-card-kicker {
    margin-bottom: 0.12rem;
    font-size: 0.64rem;
  }

  .ops-home .ops-intro {
    display: none;
  }

  .ops-section {
    margin-top: 0.62rem;
  }

  .ops-section-heading {
    padding-bottom: 0.18rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.38rem;
  }

  .ops-section-heading h2 {
    font-size: 1.12rem;
  }

  .ops-home .ops-section-heading > span {
    display: none;
  }

  .ops-grid,
  .ops-link-list {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 0.38rem;
  }

  .ops-columns {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .ops-card {
    min-height: 4.4rem;
    padding: 0.42rem 0.5rem;
    border-left-width: 0.22rem;
  }

  .ops-card strong {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    line-height: 1.15;
  }

  .ops-card > span:last-child {
    margin-top: 0.12rem;
    font-size: 0.74rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .ops-callout,
  .ops-answer {
    padding: 0.52rem 0.62rem;
    margin: 0.55rem 0;
  }

  .ops-procedure > li {
    grid-template-columns: 2rem 1fr;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.52rem 0;
  }

  .ops-procedure > li > span {
    width: 1.85rem;
    height: 1.85rem;
  }

  .ops-table th,
  .ops-table td {
    padding: 0.36rem 0.42rem;
    overflow-wrap: normal;
    word-break: normal;
  }

  .ops-table tbody th {
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ops-table-link {
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ops-action-table {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .ops-action-table thead {
    display: none;
  }

  .ops-action-table tbody,
  .ops-action-table tr,
  .ops-action-table th,
  .ops-action-table td {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .ops-action-table tr {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 0.18rem 0.65rem;
    padding: 0.52rem 0.58rem;
    background: var(--ops-panel);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  }

  .ops-action-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
    background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  }

  .ops-action-table th,
  .ops-action-table td {
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent !important;
    border: 0;
  }

  .ops-action-table th {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1;
  }

  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(2) {
    width: auto;
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 1;
    align-self: center;
  }

  .ops-action-table .ops-action-meta,
  .ops-action-table .ops-action-training {
    align-items: flex-end;
  }

  .ops-action-table .ops-action-training {
    max-width: 8.5rem;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }

  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(3),
  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(4) {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(3) {
    padding-top: 0.22rem;
    color: var(--ops-muted);
  }

  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(4) {
    padding-top: 0.08rem;
  }

  .ops-action-table .ops-table-link {
    min-height: 1.65rem;
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ops-condition-table {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .ops-condition-table thead {
    display: none;
  }

  .ops-condition-table tbody,
  .ops-condition-table tr,
  .ops-condition-table th,
  .ops-condition-table td {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .ops-condition-table tr {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 0.18rem 0.65rem;
    padding: 0.52rem 0.58rem;
    background: var(--ops-panel);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  }

  .ops-condition-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
    background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  }

  .ops-condition-table th,
  .ops-condition-table td {
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent !important;
    border: 0;
  }

  .ops-condition-table th {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1;
  }

  .ops-condition-table td:nth-child(2) {
    padding-top: 0.18rem;
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    grid-row: 2;
    color: var(--ops-muted);
  }

  .ops-condition-table td:nth-child(3) {
    width: auto;
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 1;
  }

  .ops-condition-table .ops-table-link {
    min-height: 1.65rem;
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ops-launch,
  .ops-section-heading {
    align-items: center;
    flex-direction: row;
  }

  .ops-launch > a {
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .ops-number-table {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    table-layout: fixed;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
  }

  .ops-number-table th,
  .ops-number-table td {
    padding: 0.3rem 0.16rem;
    overflow-wrap: normal;
    word-break: normal;
  }

  .ops-number-table th:first-child {
    width: 7rem;
  }

  .ops-xp-page .ops-header {
    margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
  }

  .ops-xp-page .xp-calculator {
    margin: 0;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 410px) {
  .ops-grid,
  .ops-link-list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .ops-launch,
  .ops-section-heading {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

@media only screen and (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .pf2e-ops {
    --ops-paper: #181716;
    --ops-panel: #22201f;
    --ops-panel-alt: #2b2927;
    --ops-ink: #f1ede6;
    --ops-muted: #b8b0a7;
    --ops-accent: #d17a68;
    --ops-accent-soft: #2b2927;
    --ops-green: #d2b66f;
    --ops-gold: #d2b66f;
    --ops-line: #4a4642;
    --ops-link: #68b5d2;
  }

  .ops-header {
    background-color: var(--ops-panel-alt);
    background-image: none;
  }

  .ops-callout-warn {
    background: #3b3022;
    border-left-color: #cf9b4d;
  }

  .ops-procedure > li > span {
    background: var(--ops-accent);
    color: var(--ops-paper);
  }

  .ops-launch {
    background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
    border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
    border-left: 0.35rem solid var(--ops-accent);
    color: var(--ops-ink);
  }

  .pf2e-ops .ops-action-cost img,
  .pf2e-ops .ops-symbol-row img {
    filter: invert(79%) sepia(33%) saturate(627%) hue-rotate(4deg) brightness(92%) contrast(88%);
  }
}

/* Match component surfaces when Encounter+ explicitly forces dark mode. */
[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry, #deity) .core-page {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-surface);
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
  --pico-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-h1-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-h2-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
  --pico-h3-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
  --dark-red-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
  --page-border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry, #deity) .core-page a,
[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) a {
  --pico-color: var(--pf-dark-link);
  --pico-underline: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pf-dark-link) 45%, transparent);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry, #deity) .core-page-header {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-raised);
  background-image: none;
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry, #deity) .core-page-header > * {
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry) :is(.core-page-summary, .core-facts, .core-fact, .core-feature h3),
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table,
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table :is(th, td) {
  border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry) .core-page-summary {
  color: var(--pf-dark-muted);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry) .core-section h2 {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement :is(th, td) {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement th,
[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement :is(th, td):first-child,
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table th {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-raised);
  color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement th,
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table th {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td:not(:first-child),
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-surface);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement tbody tr:nth-child(even) td:not(:first-child),
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) td {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-page);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table .deity-emphasis td {
  box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block,
[data-theme="dark"] #default {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-surface);
  border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-h1-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-h2-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
  --pico-h3-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block .header {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block .header > *,
[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block .header h1 {
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) :is(h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, strong) {
  color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block hr,
[data-theme="dark"] #default hr {
  border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) :is(th, td) {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) th,
[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) td:first-child:not(:only-child) {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-raised);
  color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) th {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td:not(:first-child) {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-surface);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) tbody tr:nth-child(even) td:not(:first-child) {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-page);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block img[src*="icons/actions/"],
[data-theme="dark"] .pf2e-ops :is(.ops-action-cost, .ops-symbol-row) img {
  filter: invert(79%) sepia(33%) saturate(627%) hue-rotate(4deg) brightness(92%) contrast(88%);
}

[data-theme="dark"] footer strong {
  color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-calculator {
  --xp-paper: #181716;
  --xp-panel: #22201f;
  --xp-panel-alt: #2b2927;
  --xp-ink: #f1ede6;
  --xp-muted: #b8b0a7;
  --xp-accent: #d17a68;
  --xp-line: #4a4642;
  --xp-link: #68b5d2;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-header,
[data-theme="dark"] .xp-calculator thead th {
  background: var(--xp-panel-alt);
  background-image: none;
  border-bottom-color: #d2b66f;
  color: var(--xp-ink);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-budget-table .is-current {
  background: var(--xp-panel-alt);
  color: var(--xp-ink);
  box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 #d2b66f;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-button,
[data-theme="dark"] .xp-remove {
  background: var(--xp-accent);
  border-color: var(--xp-accent);
  color: var(--xp-paper);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-button.secondary {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--xp-accent);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .pf2e-ops {
  --ops-paper: #181716;
  --ops-panel: #22201f;
  --ops-panel-alt: #2b2927;
  --ops-ink: #f1ede6;
  --ops-muted: #b8b0a7;
  --ops-accent: #d17a68;
  --ops-accent-soft: #2b2927;
  --ops-green: #d2b66f;
  --ops-gold: #d2b66f;
  --ops-line: #4a4642;
  --ops-link: #68b5d2;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .ops-header,
[data-theme="dark"] .ops-launch {
  background-color: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  background-image: none;
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .ops-procedure > li > span {
  background: var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-paper);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .ops-launch {
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-left: 0.35rem solid var(--ops-accent);
}

</style>
<div class="pf2e-ops">
  <nav class="ops-breadcrumbs" aria-label="Breadcrumb"><a href="/page/pf2e-operations-center">Home</a><span>›</span><a href="/page/pf2e-ops-encounters-combat">Encounters & Combat</a><span>›</span><a href="/page/pf2e-ops-recovery">Dying & Recovery</a></nav>
  <header class="ops-header">
    <p class="ops-overline">GAME MASTER OPERATIONS CENTER</p>
    <h1>Dying & Recovery</h1>
    <p>The urgent sequence for 0 HP, recovery checks, wounded, and stabilization.</p>
  </header>
  
  <section class="ops-answer"><h2>When a PC reaches 0 HP</h2><ol><li>Move their initiative to immediately before the turn that reduced them to 0 HP.</li><li>Gain dying 1, or dying 2 if the effect was a critical success by the attacker or the PC’s critical failure. Add wounded value to dying.</li><li>Fall unconscious, drop held items, and apply the normal unconscious effects.</li></ol></section>
  <div class="ops-table-wrap"><table class="ops-table"><thead><tr><th>Recovery result</th><th>Change</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    <tr><th>Critical success</th><td>Reduce dying by 2.</td></tr>
    <tr><th>Success</th><td>Reduce dying by 1.</td></tr>
    <tr><th>Failure</th><td>Increase dying by 1.</td></tr>
    <tr><th>Critical failure</th><td>Increase dying by 2.</td></tr>
  </tbody></table></div>
  <aside class="ops-callout"><strong>Recovery DC = 10 + dying value</strong><span>On losing dying, increase wounded by 1. If dying reaches 4, the character dies. A Hero Point can prevent death by spending all remaining Hero Points to lose dying and stabilize.</span></aside>
  <section class="ops-rule-links"><h2>Full rules</h2><div class="ops-grid"><a class="ops-exit-link" href="/rule/dying-rules-2325"><span>Open Full Rule</span><strong>Dying</strong></a><a class="ops-exit-link" href="/rule/recovery-checks-rules-2326"><span>Open Full Rule</span><strong>Recovery Checks</strong></a><a class="ops-exit-link" href="/rule/hero-points-rules-2333"><span>Open Full Rule</span><strong>Hero Points</strong></a></div></section>
  
    <section class="ops-related">
      <h2>Related quick guides</h2>
      <div class="ops-link-list"><a href="/page/pf2e-ops-ending-encounters"><strong>Ending encounters</strong><span>Handle immediate danger before exploration.</span></a><a href="/page/pf2e-ops-encounter-sequence"><strong>Encounter sequence</strong><span>Return to round order.</span></a></div>
    </section>
</div>

name: Ending Encounters
content:
<style data-pf2e-operations-center>

/* PF2E Operations Center --------------------------------------------------
   Scoped to system Pages so the optional GM reference never changes the
   existing rule, creature, character, or compendium presentations. */
.pf2e-ops {
  --ops-paper: #f9f5ec;
  --ops-panel: #fffdf8;
  --ops-panel-alt: #f1eadc;
  --ops-ink: #2c211b;
  --ops-muted: #655b54;
  --ops-accent: #5e0000;
  --ops-accent-soft: #eadbd3;
  --ops-green: #245735;
  --ops-gold: #dbc385;
  --ops-line: #c9bba8;
  --ops-link: #005e82;

  min-height: 100%;
  padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  background: var(--ops-paper);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.pf2e-ops *,
.pf2e-ops *::before,
.pf2e-ops *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.pf2e-ops a {
  color: var(--ops-link);
}

.ops-breadcrumbs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs > span {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a:last-of-type {
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header {
  position: relative;
  padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.65rem);
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  background-image: url('images/header-paper.jpg');
  background-size: cover;
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-top: 0.38rem solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 0.25rem;
  content: '';
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ops-accent) 0 34%, var(--ops-gold) 34% 100%);
}

.ops-header h1 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 6vw, 2.8rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.ops-header > p:last-child {
  max-width: 50rem;
  margin: 0.45rem 0 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ops-overline,
.ops-kicker,
.ops-card-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-green);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.075em;
}

.ops-section {
  margin-top: 1.2rem;
}

.ops-section-heading {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-section-heading h2,
.ops-section-heading p {
  margin: 0;
}

.ops-section-heading > span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.ops-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 15rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.7rem;
}

.ops-card {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 7.25rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-left: 0.32rem solid var(--ops-green);
  color: var(--ops-ink) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-card:hover,
.ops-card:focus-visible {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  border-left-color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-card strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.13rem;
}

.ops-card > span:last-child {
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.ops-intro,
.ops-callout {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem;
  margin: 0.85rem 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  border-left: 0.35rem solid var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-callout-warn {
  background: #f4e8cf;
  border-left-color: #9a5d18;
}

.ops-callout > strong,
.ops-intro > strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-answer {
  padding: 0.8rem 0.95rem;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-top: 0.3rem solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-answer h2,
.ops-answer p:last-child,
.ops-answer ol:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.ops-answer h2 {
  margin-top: 0;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-procedure {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  list-style: none;
  counter-reset: none;
}

.ops-procedure > li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2.5rem 1fr;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-procedure > li > span {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.35rem;
  height: 2.35rem;
  place-items: center;
  background: var(--ops-accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-procedure strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.ops-procedure p {
  margin: 0.2rem 0 0.35rem;
}

.ops-table-wrap {
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-table {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-table th,
.ops-table td {
  padding: 0.52rem 0.62rem;
  border-bottom-color: var(--ops-line);
  vertical-align: top;
}

.ops-table thead th {
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
}

.ops-table tbody th {
  color: var(--ops-green);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-table tbody th small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.1rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-weight: 400;
  white-space: normal;
}

.ops-action-group > h2 {
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
  margin: 1.2rem 0 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-action-table {
  min-width: 43rem;
}

.ops-action-cost {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  align-items: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-action-cost img {
  width: 1.35rem;
  height: 1.35rem;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.ops-action-meta,
.ops-action-training {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.ops-action-meta {
  gap: 0.28rem;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.ops-action-training {
  gap: 0.2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.ops-proficiency {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 1.25rem;
  padding: 0.12rem 0.32rem;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 0.2rem;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.035em;
  line-height: 1.05;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-proficiency-trained {
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-proficiency-untrained {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-proficiency-rank {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ops-gold) 42%, var(--ops-panel));
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-table-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-number-table td,
.ops-number-table thead th:not(:first-child) {
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.8rem;
}

/* Source-backed reference pickers show one row, not a 25-level-wide table. */
.ops-ref-picker {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  padding: 0.8rem;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-ref-picker h2 {
  margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.ops-ref-controls {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 10rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.ops-ref-controls label {
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-ref-controls select {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 2.4rem;
  margin: 0.2rem 0 0;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.45rem;
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
  font: inherit;
}

.ops-ref-values {
  margin-top: 0.65rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-ref-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 44%) minmax(0, 56%);
  gap: 0.4rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.ops-ref-row strong {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-ref-row span {
  min-width: 0;
}

.ops-ref-source {
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.ops-ref-full {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-symbol-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(7.5rem, 1fr));
  gap: 0.55rem;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
}

.ops-symbol-row > div {
  display: grid;
  min-height: 6.4rem;
  padding: 0.55rem;
  place-items: center;
  align-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-symbol-row img {
  width: 1.8rem;
  height: 1.8rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.ops-symbol-row strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-symbol-row span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.ops-checklist {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.ops-checklist li {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-checklist li:nth-child(odd) {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
}

.ops-checklist strong {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-rule-links,
.ops-related {

  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-ink) !important;

}

  margin-top: 0.15rem;

}

  text-decoration: none;

  color: var(--xp-accent, var(--ops-accent));

  font-weight: 700;
}

}

  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary::marker,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary::marker {

}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary span:last-child,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary span:last-child {

  margin-left: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 400;
}

.ops-action-disclosure .ops-table-wrap {
  margin: 0;
  border-top: 0;
}

.ops-index-disclosure .ops-link-list {
  padding-top: 0.1rem;
}

@media (max-width: 650px) {

    padding: 0.45rem;
    font-size: 0.84rem;
  }

  .ops-breadcrumbs {

    min-height: 2.1rem;

  }

    display: none;
  }

  .ops-condition-table tbody,
  .ops-condition-table tr,
  .ops-condition-table th,
  .ops-condition-table td {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;

  .ops-condition-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
    background: var(--ops-panel-alt);

    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1;

    grid-row: 2;

    margin-bottom: 0.45rem;

  <section class="ops-answer"><h2>End encounter mode when exact turn order stops mattering</h2><p>Enemies might surrender, flee beyond meaningful pursuit, become unable to threaten the party, or agree to talk. The GM decides when the encounter is resolved; it need not continue until every opponent reaches 0 HP.</p></section>

<style data-pf2e-operations-center>

/* PF2E Operations Center --------------------------------------------------
   Scoped to system Pages so the optional GM reference never changes the
   existing rule, creature, character, or compendium presentations. */
.pf2e-ops {
  --ops-paper: #f9f5ec;
  --ops-panel: #fffdf8;
  --ops-panel-alt: #f1eadc;
  --ops-ink: #2c211b;
  --ops-muted: #655b54;
  --ops-accent: #5e0000;
  --ops-accent-soft: #eadbd3;
  --ops-green: #245735;
  --ops-gold: #dbc385;
  --ops-line: #c9bba8;
  --ops-link: #005e82;

  min-height: 100%;
  padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  background: var(--ops-paper);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.pf2e-ops *,
.pf2e-ops *::before,
.pf2e-ops *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.pf2e-ops a {
  color: var(--ops-link);
}

.ops-breadcrumbs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs > span {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a:last-of-type {
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header {
  position: relative;
  padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.65rem);
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  background-image: url('images/header-paper.jpg');
  background-size: cover;
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-top: 0.38rem solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 0.25rem;
  content: '';
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ops-accent) 0 34%, var(--ops-gold) 34% 100%);
}

.ops-header h1 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 6vw, 2.8rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.ops-header > p:last-child {
  max-width: 50rem;
  margin: 0.45rem 0 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ops-overline,
.ops-kicker,
.ops-card-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-green);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.075em;
}

.ops-section {
  margin-top: 1.2rem;
}

.ops-section-heading {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-section-heading h2,
.ops-section-heading p {
  margin: 0;
}

.ops-section-heading > span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.ops-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 15rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.7rem;
}

.ops-card {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 7.25rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-left: 0.32rem solid var(--ops-green);
  color: var(--ops-ink) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-card:hover,
.ops-card:focus-visible {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  border-left-color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-card strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.13rem;
}

.ops-card > span:last-child {
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.ops-intro,
.ops-callout {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem;
  margin: 0.85rem 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  border-left: 0.35rem solid var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-callout-warn {
  background: #f4e8cf;
  border-left-color: #9a5d18;
}

.ops-callout > strong,
.ops-intro > strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-answer {
  padding: 0.8rem 0.95rem;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-top: 0.3rem solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-answer h2,
.ops-answer p:last-child,
.ops-answer ol:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.ops-answer h2 {
  margin-top: 0;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-procedure {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  list-style: none;
  counter-reset: none;
}

.ops-procedure > li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2.5rem 1fr;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-procedure > li > span {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.35rem;
  height: 2.35rem;
  place-items: center;
  background: var(--ops-accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-procedure strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.ops-procedure p {
  margin: 0.2rem 0 0.35rem;
}

.ops-table-wrap {
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-table {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-table th,
.ops-table td {
  padding: 0.52rem 0.62rem;
  border-bottom-color: var(--ops-line);
  vertical-align: top;
}

.ops-table thead th {
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
}

.ops-table tbody th {
  color: var(--ops-green);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-table tbody th small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.1rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-weight: 400;
  white-space: normal;
}

.ops-action-group > h2 {
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
  margin: 1.2rem 0 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-action-table {
  min-width: 43rem;
}

.ops-action-cost {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  align-items: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-action-cost img {
  width: 1.35rem;
  height: 1.35rem;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.ops-action-meta,
.ops-action-training {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.ops-action-meta {
  gap: 0.28rem;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.ops-action-training {
  gap: 0.2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.ops-proficiency {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 1.25rem;
  padding: 0.12rem 0.32rem;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 0.2rem;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.035em;
  line-height: 1.05;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-proficiency-trained {
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-proficiency-untrained {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-proficiency-rank {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ops-gold) 42%, var(--ops-panel));
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-table-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-number-table td,
.ops-number-table thead th:not(:first-child) {
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.8rem;
}

/* Source-backed reference pickers show one row, not a 25-level-wide table. */
.ops-ref-picker {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  padding: 0.8rem;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-ref-picker h2 {
  margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.ops-ref-controls {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 10rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.ops-ref-controls label {
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-ref-controls select {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 2.4rem;
  margin: 0.2rem 0 0;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.45rem;
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
  font: inherit;
}

.ops-ref-values {
  margin-top: 0.65rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-ref-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 44%) minmax(0, 56%);
  gap: 0.4rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.ops-ref-row strong {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-ref-row span {
  min-width: 0;
}

.ops-ref-source {
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.ops-ref-full {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-symbol-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(7.5rem, 1fr));
  gap: 0.55rem;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
}

.ops-symbol-row > div {
  display: grid;
  min-height: 6.4rem;
  padding: 0.55rem;
  place-items: center;
  align-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-symbol-row img {
  width: 1.8rem;
  height: 1.8rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.ops-symbol-row strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-symbol-row span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.ops-checklist {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.ops-checklist li {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-checklist li:nth-child(odd) {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
}

.ops-checklist strong {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-rule-links,
.ops-related {
  margin-top: 1.15rem;
}

.ops-rule-links h2,
.ops-related h2 {
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-exit-link,
.ops-link-list > a {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 3.75rem;
  padding: 0.62rem 0.75rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-ink) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-exit-link > span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ops-exit-link > strong,
.ops-link-list strong {
  color: var(--ops-link);
}

.ops-tool-link {
  border-left: 0.32rem solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-link-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 14rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.55rem;
}

.ops-link-list span {
  margin-top: 0.15rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
}

.ops-launch {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0.9rem;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  background: var(--ops-green);
  color: #fff;
}

.ops-launch h2,
.ops-launch p {
  margin: 0;
  color: inherit;
}

.ops-launch .ops-kicker {
  color: var(--ops-gold);
}

.ops-launch > a {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--ops-paper);
  color: var(--ops-accent) !important;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-footer {
  padding: 1rem 0 0.25rem;
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-disclosure {
  margin: 0.7rem 0;
}

.ops-disclosure > summary {
  min-height: 2.6rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem;
  background: var(--xp-panel-alt, var(--ops-panel-alt));
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--xp-accent, var(--ops-accent));
  color: var(--xp-accent, var(--ops-accent));
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-disclosure[open] > summary {
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary::marker,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary::marker {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary span:last-child,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary span:last-child {
  float: right;
  margin-left: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 400;
}

.ops-action-disclosure .ops-table-wrap {
  margin: 0;
  border-top: 0;
}

.ops-index-disclosure .ops-link-list {
  padding-top: 0.1rem;
}

@media (max-width: 650px) {
  .pf2e-ops {
    padding: 0.45rem;
    font-size: 0.84rem;
  }

  .ops-breadcrumbs {
    gap: 0.28rem;
    min-height: 2.1rem;
    padding: 0.1rem 0;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
  }

  .ops-breadcrumbs a {
    min-height: 1.75rem;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.3rem;
    background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
    border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  }

  .ops-header {
    padding: 0.62rem 0.72rem 0.72rem;
    border-top-width: 0.25rem;
  }

  .ops-header h1 {
    font-size: 1.58rem;
    line-height: 1.05;
  }

  .ops-header > p:last-child {
    margin-top: 0.22rem;
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  .ops-overline,
  .ops-kicker,
  .ops-card-kicker {
    margin-bottom: 0.12rem;
    font-size: 0.64rem;
  }

  .ops-home .ops-intro {
    display: none;
  }

  .ops-section {
    margin-top: 0.62rem;
  }

  .ops-section-heading {
    padding-bottom: 0.18rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.38rem;
  }

  .ops-section-heading h2 {
    font-size: 1.12rem;
  }

  .ops-home .ops-section-heading > span {
    display: none;
  }

  .ops-grid,
  .ops-link-list {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 0.38rem;
  }

  .ops-columns {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .ops-card {
    min-height: 4.4rem;
    padding: 0.42rem 0.5rem;
    border-left-width: 0.22rem;
  }

  .ops-card strong {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    line-height: 1.15;
  }

  .ops-card > span:last-child {
    margin-top: 0.12rem;
    font-size: 0.74rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .ops-callout,
  .ops-answer {
    padding: 0.52rem 0.62rem;
    margin: 0.55rem 0;
  }

  .ops-procedure > li {
    grid-template-columns: 2rem 1fr;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.52rem 0;
  }

  .ops-procedure > li > span {
    width: 1.85rem;
    height: 1.85rem;
  }

  .ops-table th,
  .ops-table td {
    padding: 0.36rem 0.42rem;
    overflow-wrap: normal;
    word-break: normal;
  }

  .ops-table tbody th {
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ops-table-link {
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ops-action-table {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .ops-action-table thead {
    display: none;
  }

  .ops-action-table tbody,
  .ops-action-table tr,
  .ops-action-table th,
  .ops-action-table td {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .ops-action-table tr {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 0.18rem 0.65rem;
    padding: 0.52rem 0.58rem;
    background: var(--ops-panel);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  }

  .ops-action-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
    background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  }

  .ops-action-table th,
  .ops-action-table td {
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent !important;
    border: 0;
  }

  .ops-action-table th {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1;
  }

  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(2) {
    width: auto;
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 1;
    align-self: center;
  }

  .ops-action-table .ops-action-meta,
  .ops-action-table .ops-action-training {
    align-items: flex-end;
  }

  .ops-action-table .ops-action-training {
    max-width: 8.5rem;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }

  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(3),
  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(4) {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(3) {
    padding-top: 0.22rem;
    color: var(--ops-muted);
  }

  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(4) {
    padding-top: 0.08rem;
  }

  .ops-action-table .ops-table-link {
    min-height: 1.65rem;
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ops-condition-table {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .ops-condition-table thead {
    display: none;
  }

  .ops-condition-table tbody,
  .ops-condition-table tr,
  .ops-condition-table th,
  .ops-condition-table td {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .ops-condition-table tr {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 0.18rem 0.65rem;
    padding: 0.52rem 0.58rem;
    background: var(--ops-panel);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  }

  .ops-condition-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
    background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  }

  .ops-condition-table th,
  .ops-condition-table td {
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent !important;
    border: 0;
  }

  .ops-condition-table th {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1;
  }

  .ops-condition-table td:nth-child(2) {
    padding-top: 0.18rem;
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    grid-row: 2;
    color: var(--ops-muted);
  }

  .ops-condition-table td:nth-child(3) {
    width: auto;
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 1;
  }

  .ops-condition-table .ops-table-link {
    min-height: 1.65rem;
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ops-launch,
  .ops-section-heading {
    align-items: center;
    flex-direction: row;
  }

  .ops-launch > a {
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .ops-number-table {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    table-layout: fixed;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
  }

  .ops-number-table th,
  .ops-number-table td {
    padding: 0.3rem 0.16rem;
    overflow-wrap: normal;
    word-break: normal;
  }

  .ops-number-table th:first-child {
    width: 7rem;
  }

  .ops-xp-page .ops-header {
    margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
  }

  .ops-xp-page .xp-calculator {
    margin: 0;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 410px) {
  .ops-grid,
  .ops-link-list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .ops-launch,
  .ops-section-heading {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

@media only screen and (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .pf2e-ops {
    --ops-paper: #181716;
    --ops-panel: #22201f;
    --ops-panel-alt: #2b2927;
    --ops-ink: #f1ede6;
    --ops-muted: #b8b0a7;
    --ops-accent: #d17a68;
    --ops-accent-soft: #2b2927;
    --ops-green: #d2b66f;
    --ops-gold: #d2b66f;
    --ops-line: #4a4642;
    --ops-link: #68b5d2;
  }

  .ops-header {
    background-color: var(--ops-panel-alt);
    background-image: none;
  }

  .ops-callout-warn {
    background: #3b3022;
    border-left-color: #cf9b4d;
  }

  .ops-procedure > li > span {
    background: var(--ops-accent);
    color: var(--ops-paper);
  }

  .ops-launch {
    background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
    border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
    border-left: 0.35rem solid var(--ops-accent);
    color: var(--ops-ink);
  }

  .pf2e-ops .ops-action-cost img,
  .pf2e-ops .ops-symbol-row img {
    filter: invert(79%) sepia(33%) saturate(627%) hue-rotate(4deg) brightness(92%) contrast(88%);
  }
}

/* Match component surfaces when Encounter+ explicitly forces dark mode. */
[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry, #deity) .core-page {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-surface);
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
  --pico-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-h1-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-h2-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
  --pico-h3-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
  --dark-red-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
  --page-border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry, #deity) .core-page a,
[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) a {
  --pico-color: var(--pf-dark-link);
  --pico-underline: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pf-dark-link) 45%, transparent);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry, #deity) .core-page-header {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-raised);
  background-image: none;
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry, #deity) .core-page-header > * {
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry) :is(.core-page-summary, .core-facts, .core-fact, .core-feature h3),
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table,
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table :is(th, td) {
  border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry) .core-page-summary {
  color: var(--pf-dark-muted);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry) .core-section h2 {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement :is(th, td) {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement th,
[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement :is(th, td):first-child,
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table th {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-raised);
  color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement th,
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table th {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td:not(:first-child),
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td {

}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement tbody tr:nth-child(even) td:not(:first-child),
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) td {

}

[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table .deity-emphasis td {

}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block,
[data-theme="dark"] #default {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-surface);
  border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-h1-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-h2-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
  --pico-h3-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block .header {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block .header > *,
[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block .header h1 {
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) :is(h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, strong) {
  color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block hr,
[data-theme="dark"] #default hr {
  border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) :is(th, td) {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) th,
[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) td:first-child:not(:only-child) {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-raised);
  color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) th {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td:not(:first-child) {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-surface);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) tbody tr:nth-child(even) td:not(:first-child) {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-page);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block img[src*="icons/actions/"],
[data-theme="dark"] .pf2e-ops :is(.ops-action-cost, .ops-symbol-row) img {
  filter: invert(79%) sepia(33%) saturate(627%) hue-rotate(4deg) brightness(92%) contrast(88%);
}

[data-theme="dark"] footer strong {
  color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-calculator {
  --xp-paper: #181716;
  --xp-panel: #22201f;
  --xp-panel-alt: #2b2927;
  --xp-ink: #f1ede6;
  --xp-muted: #b8b0a7;
  --xp-accent: #d17a68;
  --xp-line: #4a4642;
  --xp-link: #68b5d2;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-header,
[data-theme="dark"] .xp-calculator thead th {
  background: var(--xp-panel-alt);
  background-image: none;
  border-bottom-color: #d2b66f;
  color: var(--xp-ink);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-budget-table .is-current {
  background: var(--xp-panel-alt);
  color: var(--xp-ink);
  box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 #d2b66f;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-button,
[data-theme="dark"] .xp-remove {
  background: var(--xp-accent);
  border-color: var(--xp-accent);
  color: var(--xp-paper);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-button.secondary {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--xp-accent);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .pf2e-ops {
  --ops-paper: #181716;
  --ops-panel: #22201f;
  --ops-panel-alt: #2b2927;
  --ops-ink: #f1ede6;
  --ops-muted: #b8b0a7;
  --ops-accent: #d17a68;
  --ops-accent-soft: #2b2927;
  --ops-green: #d2b66f;
  --ops-gold: #d2b66f;
  --ops-line: #4a4642;
  --ops-link: #68b5d2;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .ops-header,
[data-theme="dark"] .ops-launch {
  background-color: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  background-image: none;
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .ops-procedure > li > span {
  background: var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-paper);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .ops-launch {
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-left: 0.35rem solid var(--ops-accent);
}

</style>

  <nav class="ops-breadcrumbs" aria-label="Breadcrumb"><a href="/page/pf2e-operations-center">Home</a><span>›</span><a href="/page/pf2e-ops-encounters-combat">Encounters & Combat</a><span>›</span><a href="/page/pf2e-ops-xp-difficulty">XP & Encounter Difficulty</a></nav>
  <header class="ops-header">
    <p class="ops-overline">GAME MASTER OPERATIONS CENTER</p>

  <div class="ops-table-wrap"><table class="ops-table ops-number-table"><thead><tr><th>Creature level vs party</th><th>−4</th><th>−3</th><th>−2</th><th>−1</th><th>Equal</th><th>+1</th><th>+2</th><th>+3</th><th>+4</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th>XP</th><td>10</td><td>15</td><td>20</td><td>30</td><td>40</td><td>60</td><td>80</td><td>120</td><td>160</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
