name: Compact XP Planner
content:
<style data-pf2e-operations-center>
/* Encounter XP planner: inherits the system typography and shared PF2E palette. */
.xp-calculator {
  --xp-paper: #f7f3f0;
  --xp-panel: #fbf8f2;
  --xp-panel-alt: #eee2d9;
  --xp-ink: #181512;
  --xp-muted: #645d56;
  --xp-accent: #4e1b0e;
  --xp-line: #b8afa5;
  --xp-link: #075d79;
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: 1rem;
  margin: -1rem;
  background: var(--xp-paper);
  color: var(--xp-ink);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.xp-calculator a {
  color: var(--xp-link);
}

.xp-header {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem 0.65rem;
  margin: -1rem -1rem 1rem;
  background-color: #f3e8c3;
  background-image: url('images/header-paper.jpg');
  background-repeat: repeat;
  border-bottom: 3px solid var(--xp-accent);
  color: #181512;
}

.xp-header h1,
.xp-header p {
  margin: 0;
  color: inherit;
}

.xp-header p {
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
}

.xp-remaster-mark {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.xp-calculator h2 {
  margin: 0 0 0.45rem;
  padding-bottom: 0.2rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--xp-accent);
  color: var(--xp-accent);
}

.xp-setup,
.xp-budget-panel,
.xp-roster,
.xp-reference,
.xp-native-handoff {
  padding: 0.8rem;
  margin: 0 0 0.9rem;
  background: var(--xp-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--xp-line);
}

.xp-native-handoff {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-left: 5px solid var(--xp-accent);
}

.xp-native-handoff h2,
.xp-native-handoff p {
  margin-top: 0;
}

.xp-native-handoff p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.xp-native-note,
.xp-copy-status {
  color: var(--xp-muted);
}

.xp-native-action {
  flex: 0 0 min(14rem, 32%);
  text-align: center;
}

.xp-copy-native {
  width: 100%;
}

.xp-copy-status {
  display: block;
  min-height: 1.2em;
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.xp-field-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(8rem, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.xp-calculator label {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--xp-accent);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.xp-calculator label small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
  color: var(--xp-muted);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.xp-calculator input,
.xp-calculator select {
  height: 2.35rem;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.45rem;
  margin: 0.2rem 0 0;
  background: var(--xp-paper);
  border-color: var(--xp-line);
  color: var(--xp-ink);
}

.xp-results {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.7rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
}

.xp-result-card {
  padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem;
  background: var(--xp-panel-alt);
  border-top: 4px solid var(--xp-accent);
}

.xp-result-card span,
.xp-result-card strong {
  display: block;
}

.xp-result-card span {
  color: var(--xp-muted);
}

.xp-result-card strong {
  margin-top: 0.15rem;
  color: var(--xp-accent);
  font-size: 1.5rem;
}

.xp-threat-card[data-threat="low"] { border-top-color: #92751b; }
.xp-threat-card[data-threat="moderate"] { border-top-color: #ad5f16; }
.xp-threat-card[data-threat="severe"] { border-top-color: #9e342a; }
.xp-threat-card[data-threat="extreme"] { border-top-color: #72151b; }

.xp-section-heading {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: flex-end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 0.55rem;
}

.xp-section-heading h2,
.xp-section-heading p {
  margin-top: 0;
}

.xp-section-heading p,
.xp-interpretation,
.xp-rules-note {
  color: var(--xp-muted);
}

.xp-section-heading p {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.xp-calculator table {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--xp-ink);
}

.xp-calculator th,
.xp-calculator td {
  padding: 0.35rem 0.45rem;
  border-bottom-color: var(--xp-line);
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.xp-calculator thead th {
  background: #eadbd3;
  color: var(--xp-accent);
}

.xp-budget-table tbody th,
.xp-entry-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: var(--xp-panel-alt);
}

.xp-budget-table .is-current {
  background: #dbc385;
  color: #3c1b12;
  font-weight: 700;
  box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 var(--xp-accent);
}

.xp-interpretation {
  margin: 0.55rem 0 0;
}

.xp-entry-table {
  width: 100%;
}

.xp-entry-table input,
.xp-entry-table select {
  min-width: 4.2rem;
  margin: 0;
}

.xp-entry-table .xp-entry-name { min-width: 8rem; }
.xp-entry-table .xp-entry-kind { min-width: 8.5rem; }
.xp-entry-table .xp-entry-adjustment { min-width: 7.5rem; }
.xp-entry-each,
.xp-entry-total { font-weight: 700; }

.xp-entry-table tr.has-warning td {
  background: #f7e5d1;
}

.xp-button,
.xp-remove {
  width: auto;
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--xp-accent);
  border-color: var(--xp-accent);
  color: #fff;
}

.xp-button.secondary {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--xp-accent);
}

.xp-remove {
  min-width: 2rem;
  padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.xp-actions {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  margin-top: 0.65rem;
}

.xp-warning {
  padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem;
  margin: 0.6rem 0 0;
  background: #f7e5d1;
  border-left: 4px solid #9e342a;
  color: #5e1d18;
}

.xp-reference nav {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.xp-reference nav a {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.55rem;
  background: var(--xp-panel-alt);
  border: 1px solid var(--xp-line);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.xp-reference p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.visually-hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .xp-calculator {
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 0.45rem;
    margin: -0.45rem;
    font-size: 0.86rem;
    line-height: 1.25;
  }

  .xp-header {
    gap: 0.4rem;
    padding: 0.48rem 0.55rem 0.4rem;
    margin: -0.45rem -0.45rem 0.5rem;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .xp-header h1 {
    font-size: 1.15rem;
  }

  .xp-header p,
  .xp-remaster-mark,
  .xp-native-note,
  .xp-section-heading p,
  .xp-rules-note {
    display: none;
  }

  .xp-setup,
  .xp-budget-panel,
  .xp-roster,
  .xp-reference,
  .xp-native-handoff {
    padding: 0.48rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }

  .xp-calculator h2 {
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  .xp-field-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 0.4rem;
  }

  .xp-field-grid > label:last-child {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .xp-results {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 0.35rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }

  .xp-result-card {
    padding: 0.42rem;
    border-top-width: 3px;
  }

  .xp-result-card span {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
  }

  .xp-result-card strong {
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  .xp-section-heading {
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
    align-items: center;
    flex-direction: row;
  }

  .xp-native-handoff {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    align-items: center;
    border-left-width: 3px;
  }

  .xp-native-handoff p {
    margin-bottom: 0;
    font-size: 0.76rem;
  }

  .xp-native-action {
    flex-basis: auto;
  }

  .xp-copy-native {
    width: auto;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  .xp-budget-table {
    min-width: 25rem;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
  }

  .xp-entry-table,
  .xp-entry-table tbody,
  .xp-entry-table tr,
  .xp-entry-table td {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .xp-entry-table thead {
    display: none;
  }

  .xp-entry-table tbody tr {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 0.4rem;
    padding: 0.48rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
    background: var(--xp-panel-alt);
    border: 1px solid var(--xp-line);
  }

  .xp-entry-table td {
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
  }

  .xp-entry-table td::before {
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 0.12rem;
    content: attr(data-label);
    color: var(--xp-accent);
    font-size: 0.68rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .xp-entry-table td:first-child {
    padding-right: 2.2rem;
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .xp-entry-table input,
  .xp-entry-table select,
  .xp-entry-table .xp-entry-name,
  .xp-entry-table .xp-entry-kind,
  .xp-entry-table .xp-entry-adjustment {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    height: 2rem;
  }

  .xp-entry-each,
  .xp-entry-total {
    min-height: 2rem;
    padding: 0.35rem !important;
    background: var(--xp-panel);
  }

  .xp-entry-remove-cell {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0.4rem;
    right: 0.4rem;
    width: auto !important;
  }

  .xp-entry-remove-cell::before {
    display: none !important;
  }

  .xp-remove {
    min-width: 1.8rem;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem;
  }

  .xp-actions {
    margin-top: 0.35rem;
  }

  .xp-button {
    min-height: 2.15rem;
    padding: 0.35rem 0.55rem;
  }

  .xp-reference nav {
    gap: 0.3rem;
  }

  .xp-reference nav a {
    padding: 0.28rem 0.4rem;
    font-size: 0.74rem;
  }
}

@media only screen and (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .xp-calculator {
    --xp-paper: #181716;
    --xp-panel: #22201f;
    --xp-panel-alt: #2b2927;
    --xp-ink: #f1ede6;
    --xp-muted: #b8b0a7;
    --xp-accent: #d17a68;
    --xp-line: #4a4642;
    --xp-link: #68b5d2;
  }

  .xp-header {
    background-color: var(--xp-panel-alt);
    background-image: none;
    border-bottom-color: #d2b66f;
    color: var(--xp-ink);
  }

  .xp-calculator thead th {
    background: var(--xp-panel-alt);
    color: var(--xp-accent);
    border-bottom-color: #d2b66f;
  }

  .xp-budget-table .is-current {
    background: var(--xp-panel-alt);
    color: var(--xp-ink);
    box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 #d2b66f;
  }

  .xp-entry-table tr.has-warning td,
  .xp-warning {
    background: #3b2923;
    color: #f0b8a5;
  }

  .xp-button,
  .xp-remove {
    background: var(--xp-accent);
    border-color: var(--xp-accent);
    color: var(--xp-paper);
  }

  .xp-button.secondary {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--xp-accent);
  }
}


/* PF2E Operations Center --------------------------------------------------
   Scoped to system Pages so the optional GM reference never changes the
   existing rule, creature, character, or compendium presentations. */
.pf2e-ops {
  --ops-paper: #f9f5ec;
  --ops-panel: #fffdf8;
  --ops-panel-alt: #f1eadc;
  --ops-ink: #2c211b;
  --ops-muted: #655b54;
  --ops-accent: #5e0000;
  --ops-accent-soft: #eadbd3;
  --ops-green: #245735;
  --ops-gold: #dbc385;
  --ops-line: #c9bba8;
  --ops-link: #005e82;

  min-height: 100%;
  padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  background: var(--ops-paper);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.pf2e-ops *,
.pf2e-ops *::before,
.pf2e-ops *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.pf2e-ops a {
  color: var(--ops-link);
}

.ops-breadcrumbs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs > span {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a:last-of-type {
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header {
  position: relative;
  padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.65rem);
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  background-image: url('images/header-paper.jpg');
  background-size: cover;
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-top: 0.38rem solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 0.25rem;
  content: '';
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ops-accent) 0 34%, var(--ops-gold) 34% 100%);
}

.ops-header h1 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 6vw, 2.8rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.ops-header > p:last-child {
  max-width: 50rem;
  margin: 0.45rem 0 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ops-overline,
.ops-kicker,
.ops-card-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-green);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.075em;
}

.ops-section {
  margin-top: 1.2rem;
}

.ops-section-heading {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-section-heading h2,
.ops-section-heading p {
  margin: 0;
}

.ops-section-heading > span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.ops-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 15rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.7rem;
}

.ops-card {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 7.25rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-left: 0.32rem solid var(--ops-green);
  color: var(--ops-ink) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-card:hover,
.ops-card:focus-visible {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  border-left-color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-card strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.13rem;
}

.ops-card > span:last-child {
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.ops-intro,
.ops-callout {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem;
  margin: 0.85rem 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  border-left: 0.35rem solid var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-callout-warn {
  background: #f4e8cf;
  border-left-color: #9a5d18;
}

.ops-callout > strong,
.ops-intro > strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-answer {
  padding: 0.8rem 0.95rem;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-top: 0.3rem solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-answer h2,
.ops-answer p:last-child,
.ops-answer ol:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.ops-answer h2 {
  margin-top: 0;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-procedure {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  list-style: none;
  counter-reset: none;
}

.ops-procedure > li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2.5rem 1fr;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-procedure > li > span {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.35rem;
  height: 2.35rem;
  place-items: center;
  background: var(--ops-accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-procedure strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.ops-procedure p {
  margin: 0.2rem 0 0.35rem;
}

.ops-table-wrap {
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-table {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-table th,
.ops-table td {
  padding: 0.52rem 0.62rem;
  border-bottom-color: var(--ops-line);
  vertical-align: top;
}

.ops-table thead th {
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
}

.ops-table tbody th {
  color: var(--ops-green);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-table tbody th small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.1rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-weight: 400;
  white-space: normal;
}

.ops-action-group > h2 {
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
  margin: 1.2rem 0 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-action-table {
  min-width: 43rem;
}

.ops-action-cost {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  align-items: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-action-cost img {
  width: 1.35rem;
  height: 1.35rem;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.ops-action-meta,
.ops-action-training {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.ops-action-meta {
  gap: 0.28rem;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.ops-action-training {
  gap: 0.2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.ops-proficiency {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 1.25rem;
  padding: 0.12rem 0.32rem;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 0.2rem;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.035em;
  line-height: 1.05;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-proficiency-trained {
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-proficiency-untrained {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-proficiency-rank {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ops-gold) 42%, var(--ops-panel));
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-table-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-number-table td,
.ops-number-table thead th:not(:first-child) {
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.8rem;
}

/* Source-backed reference pickers show one row, not a 25-level-wide table. */
.ops-ref-picker {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  padding: 0.8rem;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-ref-picker h2 {
  margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.ops-ref-controls {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 10rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.ops-ref-controls label {
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-ref-controls select {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 2.4rem;
  margin: 0.2rem 0 0;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.45rem;
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
  font: inherit;
}

.ops-ref-values {
  margin-top: 0.65rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-ref-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 44%) minmax(0, 56%);
  gap: 0.4rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.ops-ref-row strong {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-ref-row span {
  min-width: 0;
}

.ops-ref-source {
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.ops-ref-full {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-symbol-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(7.5rem, 1fr));
  gap: 0.55rem;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
}

.ops-symbol-row > div {
  display: grid;
  min-height: 6.4rem;
  padding: 0.55rem;
  place-items: center;
  align-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-symbol-row img {
  width: 1.8rem;
  height: 1.8rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.ops-symbol-row strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-symbol-row span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.ops-checklist {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.ops-checklist li {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-checklist li:nth-child(odd) {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
}

.ops-checklist strong {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-rule-links,
.ops-related {
  margin-top: 1.15rem;
}

.ops-rule-links h2,
.ops-related h2 {
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-exit-link,
.ops-link-list > a {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 3.75rem;
  padding: 0.62rem 0.75rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-ink) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-exit-link > span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ops-exit-link > strong,
.ops-link-list strong {
  color: var(--ops-link);
}

.ops-tool-link {
  border-left: 0.32rem solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-link-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 14rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.55rem;
}

.ops-link-list span {
  margin-top: 0.15rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
}

.ops-launch {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0.9rem;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  background: var(--ops-green);
  color: #fff;
}

.ops-launch h2,
.ops-launch p {
  margin: 0;
  color: inherit;
}

.ops-launch .ops-kicker {
  color: var(--ops-gold);
}

.ops-launch > a {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--ops-paper);
  color: var(--ops-accent) !important;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-footer {
  padding: 1rem 0 0.25rem;
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-disclosure {
  margin: 0.7rem 0;
}

.ops-disclosure > summary {
  min-height: 2.6rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem;
  background: var(--xp-panel-alt, var(--ops-panel-alt));
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--xp-accent, var(--ops-accent));
  color: var(--xp-accent, var(--ops-accent));
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-disclosure[open] > summary {
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary::marker,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary::marker {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary span:last-child,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary span:last-child {
  float: right;
  margin-left: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 400;
}

.ops-action-disclosure .ops-table-wrap {
  margin: 0;
  border-top: 0;
}

.ops-index-disclosure .ops-link-list {
  padding-top: 0.1rem;
}

@media (max-width: 650px) {
  .pf2e-ops {
    padding: 0.45rem;
    font-size: 0.84rem;
  }

  .ops-breadcrumbs {
    gap: 0.28rem;
    min-height: 2.1rem;
    padding: 0.1rem 0;
    font-size: 0.72rem;

  }

  .ops-breadcrumbs a {

  .ops-overline,

  .ops-home .ops-intro {

  }

  .ops-home .ops-section-heading > span {

  }

  .ops-grid,
  .ops-link-list {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));

  }

  .ops-columns {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .ops-card {
    min-height: 4.4rem;
    padding: 0.42rem 0.5rem;

  }

  .ops-card strong {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    line-height: 1.15;
  }

  .ops-card > span:last-child {
    margin-top: 0.12rem;
    font-size: 0.74rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .ops-callout,
  .ops-answer {
    padding: 0.52rem 0.62rem;

  }

  .ops-procedure > li {

    gap: 0.5rem;

  .ops-procedure > li > span {

  .ops-table th,
  .ops-table td {

    word-break: normal;

  .ops-table tbody th {

  }

  .ops-table-link {
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ops-action-table {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;

  .ops-action-table thead {
    display: none;
  }

  .ops-action-table tbody,
  .ops-action-table tr,
  .ops-action-table th,
  .ops-action-table td {

    padding: 0.52rem 0.58rem;

  .ops-action-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {

    grid-row: 1;

    grid-row: 2;

    grid-row: 1;

  }

    margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
  }

  .ops-xp-page .xp-calculator {
    margin: 0;
  }

@media (max-width: 410px) {

  .ops-section-heading {
    align-items: stretch;

@media only screen and (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .pf2e-ops {
    --ops-paper: #181716;
    --ops-panel: #22201f;
    --ops-panel-alt: #2b2927;

      var warning = container.querySelector("[data-xp-warning]");
      warning.hidden = result.warnings === 0;
      warning.textContent = result.warnings ? "One or more entries are outside the normal party level −4 to +4 range, or have an invalid override. Enter a nonnegative XP override to include them." : "";
      container.querySelector("[data-xp-interpretation]").textContent = result.encounterXp + " XP compared with the " + result.budgets[result.threat] + " XP " + titleCase(result.threat) + " target for " + result.partySize + " PC" + (result.partySize === 1 ? "" : "s") + ".";
      saveState(raw);
    }

    partyLevelInput.value = clamp(integer(state.partyLevel, 1), 1, 20);
    partySizeInput.value = clamp(integer(state.partySize, 4), 1, 12);
    additionalInput.value = Math.max(0, integer(state.additionalXp, 0));
    (state.entries.length ? state.entries : initialState(partyLevelInput.value).entries).forEach(addRow);

    container.addEventListener("input", render);
    container.addEventListener("change", render);
    container.querySelector("[data-xp-add-entry]").addEventListener("click", function () {
      addRow(initialState(integer(partyLevelInput.value, 1)).entries[0]);
      render();
    });
    container.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      if (!event.target.classList.contains("xp-remove")) return;
      event.target.closest("tr").remove();
      if (!entriesBody.children.length) addRow(initialState(integer(partyLevelInput.value, 1)).entries[0]);
      render();
    });
    container.querySelector("[data-xp-reset]").addEventListener("click", function () {
      var fresh = initialState(1);
      partyLevelInput.value = fresh.partyLevel;
      partySizeInput.value = fresh.partySize;
      additionalInput.value = fresh.additionalXp;
      entriesBody.textContent = "";
      fresh.entries.forEach(addRow);
      render();
    });
    container.querySelector("[data-xp-copy-native]").addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      var button = event.currentTarget;
      var status = container.querySelector("[data-xp-copy-status]");
      copyText(button.getAttribute("data-copy-value")).then(function () {
        status.textContent = "Copied. Paste this into Encounter+'s Total Experience field.";
      }).catch(function () {
        status.textContent = "Copy was blocked. Enter the displayed Native award total manually.";
      });
    });
    render();
  }

  function initializeAll() {
    var containers = document.querySelectorAll("[data-xp-calculator]");
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(containers, initialize);
  }

  if (typeof document !== "undefined") {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeAll);
    else initializeAll();
  }

  return {
    STANDARD_XP: STANDARD_XP,
    SIMPLE_HAZARD_XP: SIMPLE_HAZARD_XP,
    BASE_BUDGETS: BASE_BUDGETS,
    CHARACTER_ADJUSTMENTS: CHARACTER_ADJUSTMENTS,
    adjustedBudgets: adjustedBudgets,
    xpFor: xpFor,
    classifyThreat: classifyThreat,
    calculateEntry: calculateEntry,
    calculateEncounter: calculateEncounter,
    nativeAwardValue: nativeAwardValue
  };
});

</script>

content:
<style data-pf2e-operations-center>

/* PF2E Operations Center --------------------------------------------------
   Scoped to system Pages so the optional GM reference never changes the
   existing rule, creature, character, or compendium presentations. */
.pf2e-ops {
  --ops-paper: #f9f5ec;
  --ops-panel: #fffdf8;
  --ops-panel-alt: #f1eadc;
  --ops-ink: #2c211b;
  --ops-muted: #655b54;
  --ops-accent: #5e0000;
  --ops-accent-soft: #eadbd3;
  --ops-green: #245735;
  --ops-gold: #dbc385;
  --ops-line: #c9bba8;
  --ops-link: #005e82;

  min-height: 100%;
  padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  background: var(--ops-paper);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.pf2e-ops *,
.pf2e-ops *::before,
.pf2e-ops *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.pf2e-ops a {
  color: var(--ops-link);
}

.ops-breadcrumbs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs > span {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a:last-of-type {
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header {
  position: relative;
  padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.65rem);
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  background-image: url('images/header-paper.jpg');
  background-size: cover;
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-top: 0.38rem solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 0.25rem;
  content: '';
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ops-accent) 0 34%, var(--ops-gold) 34% 100%);
}

.ops-header h1 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 6vw, 2.8rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.ops-header > p:last-child {
  max-width: 50rem;
  margin: 0.45rem 0 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ops-overline,
.ops-kicker,
.ops-card-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-green);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.075em;
}

.ops-section {
  margin-top: 1.2rem;
}

.ops-section-heading {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-section-heading h2,
.ops-section-heading p {
  margin: 0;
}

.ops-section-heading > span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.ops-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 15rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.7rem;
}

.ops-card {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 7.25rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-left: 0.32rem solid var(--ops-green);
  color: var(--ops-ink) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-card:hover,
.ops-card:focus-visible {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  border-left-color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-card strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.13rem;
}

.ops-card > span:last-child {
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.ops-intro,
.ops-callout {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem;
  margin: 0.85rem 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  border-left: 0.35rem solid var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-callout-warn {
  background: #f4e8cf;
  border-left-color: #9a5d18;
}

.ops-callout > strong,
.ops-intro > strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-answer {
  padding: 0.8rem 0.95rem;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-top: 0.3rem solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-answer h2,
.ops-answer p:last-child,
.ops-answer ol:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.ops-answer h2 {
  margin-top: 0;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-procedure {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  list-style: none;
  counter-reset: none;
}

.ops-procedure > li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2.5rem 1fr;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-procedure > li > span {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.35rem;
  height: 2.35rem;
  place-items: center;
  background: var(--ops-accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-procedure strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.ops-procedure p {
  margin: 0.2rem 0 0.35rem;
}

.ops-table-wrap {
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-table {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-table th,
.ops-table td {
  padding: 0.52rem 0.62rem;
  border-bottom-color: var(--ops-line);
  vertical-align: top;
}

.ops-table thead th {
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
}

.ops-table tbody th {
  color: var(--ops-green);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-table tbody th small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.1rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-weight: 400;
  white-space: normal;
}

.ops-action-group > h2 {
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
  margin: 1.2rem 0 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-action-table {
  min-width: 43rem;
}

.ops-action-cost {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  align-items: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-action-cost img {
  width: 1.35rem;
  height: 1.35rem;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.ops-action-meta,
.ops-action-training {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.ops-action-meta {
  gap: 0.28rem;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.ops-action-training {
  gap: 0.2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.ops-proficiency {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 1.25rem;
  padding: 0.12rem 0.32rem;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 0.2rem;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.035em;
  line-height: 1.05;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-proficiency-trained {
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-proficiency-untrained {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-proficiency-rank {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ops-gold) 42%, var(--ops-panel));
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-table-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-number-table td,
.ops-number-table thead th:not(:first-child) {
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.8rem;
}

/* Source-backed reference pickers show one row, not a 25-level-wide table. */
.ops-ref-picker {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  padding: 0.8rem;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-ref-picker h2 {
  margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.ops-ref-controls {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 10rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.ops-ref-controls label {
  min-width: 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-ref-controls select {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: 2.4rem;
  margin: 0.2rem 0 0;
  padding: 0.3rem 0.45rem;
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
  font: inherit;
}

.ops-ref-values {
  margin-top: 0.65rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-ref-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 44%) minmax(0, 56%);
  gap: 0.4rem;
  padding: 0.45rem 0.1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}

.ops-ref-row strong {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-ref-row span {
  min-width: 0;
}

.ops-ref-source {
  margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

.ops-ref-full {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-symbol-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(7.5rem, 1fr));
  gap: 0.55rem;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
}

.ops-symbol-row > div {
  display: grid;
  min-height: 6.4rem;
  padding: 0.55rem;
  place-items: center;
  align-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-symbol-row img {
  width: 1.8rem;
  height: 1.8rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.ops-symbol-row strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-symbol-row span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.ops-checklist {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  list-style: none;
}

.ops-checklist li {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-checklist li:nth-child(odd) {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
}

.ops-checklist strong {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-rule-links,
.ops-related {
  margin-top: 1.15rem;
}

.ops-rule-links h2,
.ops-related h2 {
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-exit-link,
.ops-link-list > a {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 3.75rem;
  padding: 0.62rem 0.75rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-ink) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-exit-link > span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ops-exit-link > strong,
.ops-link-list strong {
  color: var(--ops-link);
}

.ops-tool-link {
  border-left: 0.32rem solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-link-list {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 14rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.55rem;
}

.ops-link-list span {
  margin-top: 0.15rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
}

.ops-launch {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0.9rem;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  background: var(--ops-green);
  color: #fff;
}

.ops-launch h2,
.ops-launch p {
  margin: 0;
  color: inherit;
}

.ops-launch .ops-kicker {
  color: var(--ops-gold);
}

.ops-launch > a {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--ops-paper);
  color: var(--ops-accent) !important;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-footer {
  padding: 1rem 0 0.25rem;
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-disclosure {
  margin: 0.7rem 0;
}

.ops-disclosure > summary {
  min-height: 2.6rem;
  padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem;
  background: var(--xp-panel-alt, var(--ops-panel-alt));
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--xp-accent, var(--ops-accent));
  color: var(--xp-accent, var(--ops-accent));
  cursor: pointer;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-disclosure[open] > summary {
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary::marker,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary::marker {
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-action-disclosure > summary span:last-child,
.ops-index-disclosure > summary span:last-child {
  float: right;
  margin-left: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 400;
}

.ops-action-disclosure .ops-table-wrap {
  margin: 0;
  border-top: 0;
}

.ops-index-disclosure .ops-link-list {
  padding-top: 0.1rem;
}

@media (max-width: 650px) {
  .pf2e-ops {
    padding: 0.45rem;
    font-size: 0.84rem;
  }

  .ops-breadcrumbs {
    gap: 0.28rem;
    min-height: 2.1rem;
    padding: 0.1rem 0;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
  }

  .ops-breadcrumbs a {
    min-height: 1.75rem;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.3rem;
    background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
    border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  }

  .ops-header {
    padding: 0.62rem 0.72rem 0.72rem;
    border-top-width: 0.25rem;
  }

  .ops-header h1 {
    font-size: 1.58rem;
    line-height: 1.05;
  }

  .ops-header > p:last-child {
    margin-top: 0.22rem;
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  .ops-overline,
  .ops-kicker,
  .ops-card-kicker {
    margin-bottom: 0.12rem;
    font-size: 0.64rem;
  }

  .ops-home .ops-intro {
    display: none;
  }

  .ops-section {
    margin-top: 0.62rem;
  }

  .ops-section-heading {
    padding-bottom: 0.18rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.38rem;
  }

  .ops-section-heading h2 {
    font-size: 1.12rem;
  }

  .ops-home .ops-section-heading > span {
    display: none;
  }

  .ops-grid,
  .ops-link-list {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 0.38rem;
  }

  .ops-columns {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .ops-card {
    min-height: 4.4rem;
    padding: 0.42rem 0.5rem;
    border-left-width: 0.22rem;
  }

  .ops-card strong {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    line-height: 1.15;
  }

  .ops-card > span:last-child {
    margin-top: 0.12rem;
    font-size: 0.74rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .ops-callout,
  .ops-answer {
    padding: 0.52rem 0.62rem;
    margin: 0.55rem 0;
  }

  .ops-procedure > li {
    grid-template-columns: 2rem 1fr;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.52rem 0;
  }

  .ops-procedure > li > span {
    width: 1.85rem;
    height: 1.85rem;
  }

  .ops-table th,
  .ops-table td {
    padding: 0.36rem 0.42rem;
    overflow-wrap: normal;
    word-break: normal;
  }

  .ops-table tbody th {
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ops-table-link {
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ops-action-table {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .ops-action-table thead {
    display: none;
  }

  .ops-action-table tbody,
  .ops-action-table tr,
  .ops-action-table th,
  .ops-action-table td {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .ops-action-table tr {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 0.18rem 0.65rem;
    padding: 0.52rem 0.58rem;
    background: var(--ops-panel);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  }

  .ops-action-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
    background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  }

  .ops-action-table th,
  .ops-action-table td {
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent !important;
    border: 0;
  }

  .ops-action-table th {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1;
  }

  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(2) {
    width: auto;
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 1;
    align-self: center;
  }

  .ops-action-table .ops-action-meta,
  .ops-action-table .ops-action-training {
    align-items: flex-end;
  }

  .ops-action-table .ops-action-training {
    max-width: 8.5rem;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }

  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(3),
  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(4) {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(3) {
    padding-top: 0.22rem;
    color: var(--ops-muted);
  }

  .ops-action-table td:nth-child(4) {
    padding-top: 0.08rem;
  }

  .ops-action-table .ops-table-link {
    min-height: 1.65rem;
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ops-condition-table {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .ops-condition-table thead {
    display: none;
  }

  .ops-condition-table tbody,
  .ops-condition-table tr,
  .ops-condition-table th,
  .ops-condition-table td {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .ops-condition-table tr {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 0.18rem 0.65rem;
    padding: 0.52rem 0.58rem;
    background: var(--ops-panel);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  }

  .ops-condition-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
    background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  }

  .ops-condition-table th,
  .ops-condition-table td {
    padding: 0;
    background: transparent !important;
    border: 0;
  }

  .ops-condition-table th {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1;
  }

  .ops-condition-table td:nth-child(2) {
    padding-top: 0.18rem;
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    grid-row: 2;
    color: var(--ops-muted);
  }

  .ops-condition-table td:nth-child(3) {
    width: auto;
    grid-column: 2;
    grid-row: 1;
  }

  .ops-condition-table .ops-table-link {
    min-height: 1.65rem;
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ops-launch,
  .ops-section-heading {
    align-items: center;
    flex-direction: row;
  }

  .ops-launch > a {
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .ops-number-table {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    table-layout: fixed;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
  }

  .ops-number-table th,
  .ops-number-table td {
    padding: 0.3rem 0.16rem;
    overflow-wrap: normal;
    word-break: normal;
  }

  .ops-number-table th:first-child {
    width: 7rem;
  }

  .ops-xp-page .ops-header {
    margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
  }

  .ops-xp-page .xp-calculator {
    margin: 0;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 410px) {
  .ops-grid,
  .ops-link-list {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .ops-launch,
  .ops-section-heading {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
}

@media only screen and (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  .pf2e-ops {
    --ops-paper: #181716;
    --ops-panel: #22201f;
    --ops-panel-alt: #2b2927;
    --ops-ink: #f1ede6;
    --ops-muted: #b8b0a7;
    --ops-accent: #d17a68;
    --ops-accent-soft: #2b2927;
    --ops-green: #d2b66f;
    --ops-gold: #d2b66f;
    --ops-line: #4a4642;
    --ops-link: #68b5d2;
  }

  .ops-header {
    background-color: var(--ops-panel-alt);
    background-image: none;
  }

  .ops-callout-warn {
    background: #3b3022;
    border-left-color: #cf9b4d;
  }

  .ops-procedure > li > span {
    background: var(--ops-accent);
    color: var(--ops-paper);
  }

  .ops-launch {
    background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
    border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
    border-left: 0.35rem solid var(--ops-accent);
    color: var(--ops-ink);
  }

  .pf2e-ops .ops-action-cost img,
  .pf2e-ops .ops-symbol-row img {
    filter: invert(79%) sepia(33%) saturate(627%) hue-rotate(4deg) brightness(92%) contrast(88%);
  }
}

/* Match component surfaces when Encounter+ explicitly forces dark mode. */
[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry, #deity) .core-page {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-surface);
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
  --pico-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-h1-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-h2-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
  --pico-h3-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
  --dark-red-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
  --page-border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry, #deity) .core-page a,
[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) a {
  --pico-color: var(--pf-dark-link);
  --pico-underline: color-mix(in srgb, var(--pf-dark-link) 45%, transparent);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry, #deity) .core-page-header {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-raised);
  background-image: none;
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry, #deity) .core-page-header > * {
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry) :is(.core-page-summary, .core-facts, .core-fact, .core-feature h3),
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table,
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table :is(th, td) {
  border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry) .core-page-summary {
  color: var(--pf-dark-muted);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(#class, #ancestry) .core-section h2 {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement :is(th, td) {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement th,
[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement :is(th, td):first-child,
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table th {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-raised);
  color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement th,
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table th {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td:not(:first-child),
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-surface);
}

[data-theme="dark"] #class .core-advancement tbody tr:nth-child(even) td:not(:first-child),
[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) td {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-page);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .deity-stat-table .deity-emphasis td {
  box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block,
[data-theme="dark"] #default {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-surface);
  border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-h1-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-h2-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
  --pico-h3-color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block .header {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block .header > *,
[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block .header h1 {
  color: var(--pf-dark-text);
  --pico-color: var(--pf-dark-text);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) :is(h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, strong) {
  color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block hr,
[data-theme="dark"] #default hr {
  border-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) :is(th, td) {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-border);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) th,
[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) td:first-child:not(:only-child) {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-raised);
  color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) th {
  border-bottom-color: var(--pf-dark-gold);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) tbody tr:nth-child(odd) td:not(:first-child) {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-surface);
}

[data-theme="dark"] :is(.stat-block, #default) table:not([class]) tbody tr:nth-child(even) td:not(:first-child) {
  background-color: var(--pf-dark-page);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .stat-block img[src*="icons/actions/"],
[data-theme="dark"] .pf2e-ops :is(.ops-action-cost, .ops-symbol-row) img {
  filter: invert(79%) sepia(33%) saturate(627%) hue-rotate(4deg) brightness(92%) contrast(88%);
}

[data-theme="dark"] footer strong {
  color: var(--pf-dark-crimson);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-calculator {
  --xp-paper: #181716;
  --xp-panel: #22201f;
  --xp-panel-alt: #2b2927;
  --xp-ink: #f1ede6;
  --xp-muted: #b8b0a7;
  --xp-accent: #d17a68;
  --xp-line: #4a4642;
  --xp-link: #68b5d2;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-header,
[data-theme="dark"] .xp-calculator thead th {
  background: var(--xp-panel-alt);
  background-image: none;
  border-bottom-color: #d2b66f;
  color: var(--xp-ink);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-budget-table .is-current {
  background: var(--xp-panel-alt);
  color: var(--xp-ink);
  box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 #d2b66f;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-button,
[data-theme="dark"] .xp-remove {
  background: var(--xp-accent);
  border-color: var(--xp-accent);
  color: var(--xp-paper);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .xp-button.secondary {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--xp-accent);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .pf2e-ops {
  --ops-paper: #181716;
  --ops-panel: #22201f;
  --ops-panel-alt: #2b2927;
  --ops-ink: #f1ede6;
  --ops-muted: #b8b0a7;
  --ops-accent: #d17a68;
  --ops-accent-soft: #2b2927;
  --ops-green: #d2b66f;
  --ops-gold: #d2b66f;
  --ops-line: #4a4642;
  --ops-link: #68b5d2;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .ops-header,
[data-theme="dark"] .ops-launch {
  background-color: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  background-image: none;
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .ops-procedure > li > span {
  background: var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-paper);
}

[data-theme="dark"] .ops-launch {
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-left: 0.35rem solid var(--ops-accent);
}

</style>
<div class="pf2e-ops">
  <nav class="ops-breadcrumbs" aria-label="Breadcrumb"><a href="/page/pf2e-operations-center">Home</a><span>›</span><a href="/page/pf2e-ops-checks-dcs-actions">Checks, DCs & Skill Actions</a></nav>
  <header class="ops-header">
    <p class="ops-overline">GAME MASTER OPERATIONS CENTER</p>
    <h1>Checks, DCs & Skill Actions</h1>
    <p>The table path from player intent to a clear, consistent outcome.</p>
  </header>
  
  <section class="ops-intro ops-callout"><strong>Start with the character’s intent.</strong><span>Pick the action that matches what they are attempting, then choose the DC and resolve the result. Do not begin with a skill name if the fiction points to a different action.</span></section>
  <section class="ops-section"><div class="ops-section-heading"><div><p class="ops-kicker">ADJUDICATE</p><h2>From intent to outcome</h2></div><span>Choose a task</span></div><div class="ops-grid">
      <a class="ops-card" href="/page/pf2e-ops-dcs">
        <span class="ops-card-kicker">SET THE TARGET</span>
        <strong>Choose a DC</strong>
        <span>Simple and level-based DCs with deliberate difficulty adjustments.</span>
      </a>
      <a class="ops-card" href="/page/pf2e-ops-check-results">
        <span class="ops-card-kicker">READ THE ROLL</span>
        <strong>Resolve a check</strong>
        <span>Bonuses, penalties, natural 20 and 1, and degrees of success.</span>
      </a>
      <a class="ops-card" href="/page/pf2e-ops-skill-actions">
        <span class="ops-card-kicker">ACTION FINDER</span>
        <strong>Find a skill action</strong>
        <span>Browse by intent: move, influence, investigate, hide, or recover.</span>
      </a>
      <a class="ops-card" href="/page/pf2e-ops-secret-checks">
        <span class="ops-card-kicker">GM ROLLS</span>
        <strong>Secret checks</strong>
        <span>Preserve uncertainty without hiding meaningful choices from players.</span>
      </a>
      <a class="ops-card" href="/page/pf2e-ops-recall-knowledge">
        <span class="ops-card-kicker">REVEAL INFO</span>
        <strong>Recall Knowledge</strong>
        <span>Choose the skill and DC, then reveal useful, actionable information.</span>
      </a>
      <a class="ops-card" href="/page/pf2e-ops-aid">
        <span class="ops-card-kicker">TEAMWORK</span>
        <strong>Aid & teamwork</strong>
        <span>Prepare help, resolve the reaction, and apply the proficiency-scaled bonus.</span>
      </a></div></section>
  <aside class="ops-callout ops-callout-warn"><strong>No action exactly fits?</strong><span>Use the closest structure, set a DC from the subject’s level or required proficiency, state the stakes, and keep the ruling consistent for comparable attempts.</span></aside>

name: DCs at a Glance
content:
<style data-pf2e-operations-center>

/* PF2E Operations Center --------------------------------------------------
   Scoped to system Pages so the optional GM reference never changes the
   existing rule, creature, character, or compendium presentations. */
.pf2e-ops {
  --ops-paper: #f9f5ec;
  --ops-panel: #fffdf8;
  --ops-panel-alt: #f1eadc;
  --ops-ink: #2c211b;
  --ops-muted: #655b54;
  --ops-accent: #5e0000;
  --ops-accent-soft: #eadbd3;
  --ops-green: #245735;
  --ops-gold: #dbc385;
  --ops-line: #c9bba8;
  --ops-link: #005e82;

  min-height: 100%;
  padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  background: var(--ops-paper);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.pf2e-ops *,
.pf2e-ops *::before,
.pf2e-ops *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.pf2e-ops a {
  color: var(--ops-link);
}

.ops-breadcrumbs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs > span {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a:last-of-type {
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header {
  position: relative;
  padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.65rem);
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  background-image: url('images/header-paper.jpg');
  background-size: cover;
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-top: 0.38rem solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 0.25rem;
  content: '';
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ops-accent) 0 34%, var(--ops-gold) 34% 100%);
}

.ops-header h1 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 6vw, 2.8rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.ops-header > p:last-child {
  max-width: 50rem;
  margin: 0.45rem 0 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ops-overline,
.ops-kicker,
.ops-card-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-green);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.075em;
}

.ops-section {
  margin-top: 1.2rem;
}

.ops-section-heading {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-section-heading h2,
.ops-section-heading p {
  margin: 0;
}

.ops-section-heading > span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.ops-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 15rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.7rem;
}

.ops-card {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 7.25rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-left: 0.32rem solid var(--ops-green);
  color: var(--ops-ink) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-card:hover,
.ops-card:focus-visible {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  border-left-color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-card strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.13rem;
}

.ops-card > span:last-child {
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.ops-intro,
.ops-callout {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem;
  margin: 0.85rem 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  border-left: 0.35rem solid var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-callout-warn {
  background: #f4e8cf;
  border-left-color: #9a5d18;
}

.ops-callout > strong,
.ops-intro > strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-answer {
  padding: 0.8rem 0.95rem;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-top: 0.3rem solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-answer h2,
.ops-answer p:last-child,
.ops-answer ol:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.ops-answer h2 {
  margin-top: 0;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-procedure {
  padding: 0;
  margin: 1rem 0;
  list-style: none;
  counter-reset: none;
}

.ops-procedure > li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2.5rem 1fr;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-procedure > li > span {
  display: grid;
  width: 2.35rem;
  height: 2.35rem;
  place-items: center;
  background: var(--ops-accent);
  border-radius: 50%;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.ops-procedure strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.ops-procedure p {
  margin: 0.2rem 0 0.35rem;
}

.ops-table-wrap {
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-table {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-table th,
.ops-table td {
  padding: 0.52rem 0.62rem;
  border-bottom-color: var(--ops-line);
  vertical-align: top;
}

.ops-table thead th {
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
}

.ops-table tbody th {
  color: var(--ops-green);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-table tbody th small {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 0.1rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-weight: 400;
  white-space: normal;
}

.ops-action-group > h2 {
  padding-bottom: 0.3rem;
  margin: 1.2rem 0 0;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-action-table {
  min-width: 43rem;
}

.ops-action-cost {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  align-items: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-action-cost img {
  width: 1.35rem;
  height: 1.35rem;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.ops-action-meta,
.ops-action-training {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.ops-action-meta {
  gap: 0.28rem;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.ops-action-training {
  gap: 0.2rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.ops-proficiency {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 1.25rem;
  padding: 0.12rem 0.32rem;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 0.2rem;
  font-size: 0.64rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.035em;
  line-height: 1.05;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-proficiency-trained {
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-proficiency-untrained {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  color: var(--ops-green);
}

.ops-proficiency-rank {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ops-gold) 42%, var(--ops-panel));
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-table-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-height: 2.5rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-number-table td,
.ops-number-table thead th:not(:first-child) {
  text-align: center;
}

.ops-columns {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.8rem;
}

/* Source-backed reference pickers show one row, not a 25-level-wide table. */
.ops-ref-picker {
  min-width: 0;
  margin: 0.9rem 0;
  padding: 0.8rem;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
}

.ops-ref-picker h2 {
  margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

Apply a rarity adjustment or difficulty adjustment only when the situation truly differs from the baseline; avoid stacking several labels for one reason.</span></aside>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function render(picker, tables) {
    var level = picker.querySelector("[data-ops-level]").value;
    var stat = picker.querySelector("[data-ops-stat]");
    var table = tables[stat ? Number(stat.value) : 0];
    var row = table.rows.find(function (candidate) { return candidate[0] === level; });
    if (!row) return;

    var result = picker.querySelector("[data-ops-values]");
    result.replaceChildren();
    table.headers.slice(1).forEach(function (header, index) {
      var pair = document.createElement("div");
      pair.className = "ops-ref-row";
      var label = document.createElement("strong");
      label.textContent = header;
      var value = document.createElement("span");
      value.textContent = row[index + 1].replace(/\*\*/g, "");
      pair.append(label, value);
      result.appendChild(pair);
    });
    picker.querySelector("[data-ops-source]").textContent = table.source;
    var full = picker.querySelector("[data-ops-full]");
    full.href = "/table/" + table.slug;
    full.textContent = "Open full " + table.name + " table";
  }

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-ops-reference]").forEach(function (picker) {
    var tables = JSON.parse(picker.querySelector("[data-ops-payload]").textContent);
    picker.querySelector("[data-ops-level]").addEventListener("change", function () { render(picker, tables); });
    var stat = picker.querySelector("[data-ops-stat]");
    if (stat) stat.addEventListener("change", function () { render(picker, tables); });
  });
})();

</script>

<style data-pf2e-operations-center>

<style data-pf2e-operations-center>

/* PF2E Operations Center --------------------------------------------------
   Scoped to system Pages so the optional GM reference never changes the
   existing rule, creature, character, or compendium presentations. */
.pf2e-ops {
  --ops-paper: #f9f5ec;
  --ops-panel: #fffdf8;
  --ops-panel-alt: #f1eadc;
  --ops-ink: #2c211b;
  --ops-muted: #655b54;
  --ops-accent: #5e0000;
  --ops-accent-soft: #eadbd3;
  --ops-green: #245735;
  --ops-gold: #dbc385;
  --ops-line: #c9bba8;
  --ops-link: #005e82;

  min-height: 100%;
  padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  background: var(--ops-paper);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.pf2e-ops *,
.pf2e-ops *::before,
.pf2e-ops *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.pf2e-ops a {
  color: var(--ops-link);
}

.ops-breadcrumbs {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  min-height: 2.75rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0;
  overflow-x: auto;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  min-height: 2.25rem;
  align-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs > span {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.ops-breadcrumbs a:last-of-type {
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header {
  position: relative;
  padding: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.65rem);
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  background-image: url('images/header-paper.jpg');
  background-size: cover;
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-top: 0.38rem solid var(--ops-accent);
  color: var(--ops-ink);
}

.ops-header::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 0.25rem;
  content: '';
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ops-accent) 0 34%, var(--ops-gold) 34% 100%);
}

.ops-header h1 {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 6vw, 2.8rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
}

.ops-header > p:last-child {
  max-width: 50rem;
  margin: 0.45rem 0 0;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.ops-overline,
.ops-kicker,
.ops-card-kicker {
  margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-green);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.075em;
}

.ops-section {
  margin-top: 1.2rem;
}

.ops-section-heading {
  display: flex;
  gap: 1rem;
  align-items: end;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-section-heading h2,
.ops-section-heading p {
  margin: 0;
}

.ops-section-heading > span {
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}

.ops-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 15rem), 1fr));
  gap: 0.7rem;
}

.ops-card {
  display: flex;
  min-height: 7.25rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--ops-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--ops-line);
  border-left: 0.32rem solid var(--ops-green);
  color: var(--ops-ink) !important;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ops-card:hover,
.ops-card:focus-visible {
  background: var(--ops-panel-alt);
  border-left-color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-card strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
  font-size: 1.13rem;
}

.ops-card > span:last-child {
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
  color: var(--ops-muted);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

.ops-intro,
.ops-callout {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem;
  margin: 0.85rem 0;
  flex-direction: column;
  background: var(--ops-accent-soft);
  border-left: 0.35rem solid var(--ops-green);

.ops-callout-warn {

  border-left-color: #9a5d18;
}

.ops-callout > strong,
.ops-intro > strong {
  color: var(--ops-accent);
}

.ops-answer {
